ddl.definition: SELECT c.classification_id, c.ts, c.event_type, c.fall_type, c.max_smv, c.max_rotation, c.freefall_duration, c.tilt_change, c.responsiveness, c.activity_before_event, c.session_id, c.worker_id, w.worker_name, w.worker_uuid, s.device_id, d.ble_address, s.start_time AS session_start_time, s.end_time AS session_end_time, s.token_expires_at, a.severity, a.acknowledged, a.acknowledged_at FROM fall_detection.classification c JOIN identification.workers w ON c.worker_id::text = w.worker_id::text JOIN monitoring.sessions s ON c.session_id = s.session_id AND c.worker_id::text = s.worker_id::text JOIN identification.devices d ON s.device_id = d.device_id LEFT JOIN fall_detection.alerts a ON a.classification_id = c.classification_id WHERE c.event_type::text <> 'NORMAL'::text ORDER BY c.ts DESC
